body.statement: Under the balanced rank-one one-chart assumptions, the synchronization gauge is \(1\) and no graph transport is performed. On \(\mathcal G_n\), every local spectral, anchor-regression, deterministic aggregation, and completed pilot block used by \(F_n\) has operator-norm error at most \(\tau_n=32\varepsilon_n\). In particular, the post-synchronization envelope is homogeneous of noise order \(\tau_n=O(\sigma\sqrt n)\).
body.justification: The one-chart calculation isolates the exact perturbation scale before nonlinear block transport.
body.gap: Published four-block analyses control scalar entries; this lemma records the joint operator envelope required by a nuclear-radius Taylor bound.
body.consumer: The balanced radius audit substitutes this envelope into every first- and second-order certificate term.
